events.body:
## Context

`src/scripts/sizzle-ui.js` appends toasts to a plain `.toast-container` div (no live region) on every page, and `openSheet`/`openModal` don't handle Escape or move focus.

## What to do

1. In sizzle-ui.js, give the container `role="status" aria-live="polite"` (no HTML edits needed).
2. Close the active sheet/modal on Escape and focus its first focusable element on open.
3. Add a contract test in `tests/test_frontend_contract.py`.

> **Note:** Don't touch the reminder settings, scheduler or email code; that work just landed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Toasts are announced
- [ ] Escape closes the sheet/modal
- [ ] Test passes

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-sizzle
```
